name: 小箱怪
evolution: 小箱怪 → 迷迷箱怪 Lv.36
description: 被当作具有自我意识的宝箱，又因为与宝箱形似，变成了象征宝箱的吉祥物精灵。有些洛克会对着小箱怪祈祷好运，甚至向它投掷洛克贝许愿。
descriptionEn: Regarded as a treasure chest with self-awareness, and because it resembles a treasure chest, it has become a mascot sprite symbolizing treasure chests. Some Lockes pray to Xiaoxiangguai for good luck, even throwing Roche shells at it to make wishes.

skills.name: 杠杆置换
skills.description: 自己回复2能量，交换两侧技能位置。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 2 energy; swaps the positions of side skills.

skills.name: 粒子对撞
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 能量守恒
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：两侧技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: side skills' energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 离子震荡
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于3号位时威力+40，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when this skill is in slot 3, power +40; Transmission 1.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed +30; when in slot 1 or 3, additionally gains ATK +80%; Transmission 1.

skills.name: 星云漩涡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 星链
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击使敌方获得1层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit grants the enemy 1 layer of Starfall Mark.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 主轴
skills.description: 造成物伤，此技能位置不会改变。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; this skill's position does not change.

skills.name: 冥想
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; against attacks: enemy gains 2 layers of Starfall Mark.

skills.name: 磁暴
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时威力+30，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when in slot 1 or 3, power +30; Transmission 1.

skills.name: 双星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 齿轮切开
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时能耗-2，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when in slot 1 or 3, energy cost -2; Transmission 1.

skills.name: 错乱
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：敌方获得3层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; against status: enemy gains 3 layers of Starfall Mark.
